NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Applicant: Smart & Final
Design Review for the construction of a new 29,996 sf retail building and site improvements for a new Smart & Final Extra grocery store. Use Permit for the off-site consumption of alcohol. Minor Use Permit for extended business operating hours. Variances for front setbacks, rear setbacks, building location, building entrance, maximum wall plane, window glazing and Minor Variance for side setback. The project will also merge a total of 5 parcels. The project site is located within the Downtown Expansion District of the Azusa TOD Specific Plan on the northeast corner of Dalton Avenue and Foothill Boulevard.
